title: Gradient descent on a contour model
label: A laminated board stack carved into nine elliptical terraces of f = ½x² + 3y², on a base with a rate knob, a peg rail and a loss column. Pins on stems strung with a black thread zigzag across the narrow valley to a black current pin.
caption: At η 0.30 each step shrinks x by 0.7 but flips y and keeps 0.8 of it, so the thread zigzags across the narrow valley; slide across the figure to turn the knob and rerun the descent at η 0.01 to 0.30.
